title: Super Real Mahjong P.V
overview:
Super Real Mahjong P.V brings Seta's adult arcade mahjong game to the Sega Saturn. Play one-on-one mahjong against the girls Mizuki, Aya and Akira, and win hands to see their animated scenes, from the opening all the way to the ending. Because the game is rated for adults only, the artwork is uncensored.

- Same cuts and animation frames as the arcade original
- Upgraded background music, plus extra recorded lines that the arcade board had no room for
- Eight difficulty levels, as in the arcade
- Arcade board settings carried over as options, including what happens when you lose a hand
- No coins or credits: continue as often as you like
- Three bonus pictures, one for each girl, hidden in the game
- Played with the standard control pad
